statusTaxonomy.IMPLEMENTED: Code implementation completed and statically checked
statusTaxonomy.TESTED: Covered by dedicated unit/integration tests with real assert failures on regression
statusTaxonomy.MEASURED: Empirical metrics gathered via reproducible execution runs
statusTaxonomy.QUALIFIED: Passed formal regression, finite, shape, and behavioral criteria
statusTaxonomy.BLOCKED_OR_NOT_RUN: Explicitly blocked or skipped due to physical constraints or missing historical data

R8-01.title: P0 Structural Defect Remediation (Model Identity, Spatial Predict Signature, NET_A TopIndex, Finite Assertions)

details.spatialPredictSignature: Enforced strictly 2-argument signature predictor.predict(encodedState, candidateActions). Refactor eliminated silent legal[0] fallbacks.
details.netAValueSupervisionAndTopIndex: Fixed undefined/null value targets by setting valueWeight: 0.0 in training, and handled topIndex / bestActionIndex cleanly.
details.modelIdentityFreezing: Explicit requested vs actual policy tracking in MatchOutcome. Mismatched or missing models throw MODEL_LOAD_ERROR / NOT_RUN, never silently substituting another model.
details.finiteWeightAssertions: Strict Number.isFinite() check on all exported model weights for Spatial ResNet and NET_A DualHead.

R8-02.title: Protocol & Engine Defect Remediation (Stagnation, Step Bounds, PRNG, Rehire Accounting)

details.stagnationTruncation: Abolished artificial 25-step unchanged unit count truncation. Replaced with true terminal or maxAtomicSteps limit.
details.implicitStepBounds: Decoupled maxTurns and step limit; removed hardcoded maxTurns * 10 limit.
details.independentPrngStreams: Seeded candidate, opponent, and search policies with independent deterministic PRNG streams.
details.rehireAccounting: Rehire opportunities and successes now reflect true engine legal recruit_to_castle actions.

R8-03.title: Historical Checkpoint Audit & Clean Baseline Benchmark

original_v7_weights.details: Original v7 weights (SHA fefc8660...) are unrecoverable from disk and git history. Formally marked BLOCKED/NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.

v7_01_100_sample_audit.details: Audited v7_01 checkpoint (SHA 43c0d748...); confirmed it was trained on only 95 samples and is not representative of a full model.

clean_v8_final_benchmark.details: Evaluated 120 matches across 6 policies (HEURISTIC, SPATIAL_V2, SPATIAL_DAGGER, NET_A, S00_SEARCH, S10_SPATIAL_SEARCH) using newly trained pilot checkpoints under maxAtomicSteps=800.

R8-04.title: Bounded Search Regression & Response Chain Hardening

details.deepWaterBug: Fixed deep water territory bug in evaluatePositionHeuristic (terrainId 2 non-building tiles excluded from territory bonus).
details.budgetEnforcement: Verified maxDepth and maxNodes quotas in getFilteredCandidateActions.
details.suicidalAvoidance: Verified that search avoids suicidal moves and defends against adjacent lethal threats.
details.deterministicReplay: Verified bitwise identical search tree expansions under fixed seed and node budget.

R8-05.title: Real Curriculum Generation, Manifest Metadata & Behavioral Hash

details.scenarioEPending: Fixed Scenario E pendingUnitId clearing bug (move + wait deployment). Generated 126 verified legal Scenario E samples (verified countE > 0).
details.manifestMetadata: Dynamic runId propagation in manifest generation.
details.sampleIdTracking: Exported non-empty train_sample_ids (6,528) and val_sample_ids (1,304) in consumed_samples_manifest.json.
details.behavioralHash: Fixed APK map name extraction in getBehavioralStateHash across 11 distinct state dimensions.

R8-06.title: Overfit Sanity & Scale Pipeline (10k Pilot vs 30k Scale)

details.overfitSanity: Verified training loss strictly descends over epochs, validation accuracy > 20%, and zero validation leakage across root families.
details.tenKPilot: Completed 10k target (7,832 unique verified states: 7,000 skirmish + 832 curriculum A-G).
details.thirtyKScale: 30,000 target marked as BLOCKED_OR_NOT_RUN (computational budget limit; not conflated with 10k pilot).

R8-07.title: Two-Seat Counterfactual DAgger Loop & Paired Evaluation

details.failureWindowsLogged: Logged 61 real failure events to failure_windows.json across both seats (P0 and P1).
details.distinctCheckpoint: Warm-start DAgger produced distinct SHA-256 (efec05c0... vs base 1721ca17...).
details.pairedEvaluation: 40 matches evaluated. Rehire rate improved (93.3% across 15 opportunities vs 100% across 6 for base, showing survival into deeper tactical states). Natural win rate remains 0% vs 10%, directional change only, not statistically significant (overlapping Wilson intervals).

overallVerdict.defaultProductionAI: HeuristicAI (strictly retained as default engine AI, untouched)
overallVerdict.candidateModelReadiness: NOT_PRODUCTION_READY. Bounded search S00 achieves 50% effective win rate, while policy ResNet models require further scale and multi-turn value supervision before deployment.
recommendations: Explore S00 Bounded Search as high-tier bot opponent in offline skirmish.
Do not push or deploy neural models until large-scale multi-turn value training is achieved.
